name: Banh beo
summary: Quảng Ngãi bánh bèo is a small rice cake with a thicker batter than Hue’s, topped with shrimp and minced pork. Pour fish sauce over it while it is hot and eat it with a small aluminum spoon.
howToEat: ZaloPay: a thicker rice batter than the Hue cake, a topping of shrimp and minced pork, and fish sauce. Eaten with a small aluminum spoon, sauce poured on the hot cake.
The culture office lists bánh bèo among the dishes at the Don An Phú festival.
where: The festival ground south of cầu Cổ Lũy, thôn Phú Thọ, when Lễ hội Don An Phú is on.
seoDescription: Quảng Ngãi bánh bèo, a thicker rice cake than Hue’s, topped with shrimp and minced pork and eaten hot with fish sauce.
